aggressive.read: This aggressive growth plan aims for stretched growth, targeting approximately ~4%/month. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware this raises both upside and drawdown potential; leveraged ETFs decay daily, and losses can be substantial if stops are not strictly adhered to.
